title: ClinicalDecisionResult
description:
Top-level result of the Clinical Decision Engine. Encapsulates the final clinical decision for a patient based on the recommendation pipeline output, evidence data, patient profile, and variant information.

Each decision carries a decision type, human-readable reason, evidence summary, confidence level, alternative options, and contraindication information for full clinical auditability.

decision_type.description: Clinical decision classification. One of: approved (strong evidence supports use), off_label (evidence exists but drug not formally approved for this indication), clinical_trial (drug should be considered in a trial context), contraindicated (safety or resistance signals preclude use), experimental (only preclinical/early evidence), not_recommended (insufficient evidence to support use).

reason.description: Human-readable, multi-sentence explanation of the clinical decision. Summarises the decision type, evidence strength, confidence, sources reviewed, and any notable resistance or contraindication signals.
examples: Recommended: Osimertinib is supported by strong evidence. The strongest evidence tier observed is Tier_1 across 12 evidence item(s). Overall confidence in this decision is high. Evidence sources reviewed: CIViC, COSMIC, ClinicalTrials.gov, OncoKB.

evidence_summary.description: Structured summary of the evidence that informed the decision. Contains counts, best tier, sources, and directional breakdown.

total_evidence_count.description: Total number of evidence items reviewed for the top recommended drug.

best_evidence_tier.description: The highest (strongest) evidence tier observed across all evidence items.

sources.description: Sorted list of distinct evidence sources that contributed.

direction_breakdown.description: Count of evidence items by direction.

supporting.description: Number of evidence items supporting the drug.

resistance.description: Number of evidence items indicating resistance.

conflicting.description: Number of evidence items with conflicting direction.

neutral.description: Number of evidence items with neutral or unknown direction.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the clinical decision. Derived from evidence tiers, source consensus, and conflict detection.

alternatives.description: List of alternative drug options (ranked 2nd and below). Each alternative includes drug name, rank, score, and rationale. Empty when there is only one candidate drug or no ranked list.

contraindications.description: List of contraindication or safety signals detected for the top recommended drug. Each entry describes the type, detail, and severity of the contraindication. Empty when no contraindications are found.

DecisionOption.title: DecisionOption
DecisionOption.description: An alternative drug option that could be considered instead of the primary recommendation. Carries ranking context and a brief rationale for why it is an alternative.

rank.description: 1-based rank position of this alternative among all scored drugs.

overall_score.description: Composite overall score for this alternative drug, as computed by the DrugRankingEngine.

rationale.description: Brief human-readable rationale explaining why this drug is listed as an alternative.

ContraindicationInfo.title: ContraindicationInfo
ContraindicationInfo.description: A single contraindication or safety signal detected for a drug. Describes the nature, detail, and severity level to help clinicians assess risk.

drug.description: Name of the drug this contraindication applies to.

type.description: Category of contraindication. One of: variant_resistance (genetic variant indicates resistance), evidence_contraindication (evidence source explicitly contraindicates), allergy (patient allergy documented), drug_interaction (potential interaction with current medications).

detail.description: Human-readable description of the contraindication, including specific genes, evidence sources, or patient conditions involved.
examples: Variant in EGFR T790M has clinical significance 'resistance' indicating possible resistance to Osimertinib.
Patient has a documented allergy to 'Osimertinib'.

severity.description: Clinical severity assessment of this contraindication. high (absolute contraindication, strongly avoid), medium (relative contraindication, use with caution), low (minor concern, monitor).

examples.reason: Recommended: Osimertinib is supported by strong evidence. The strongest evidence tier observed is Tier_1 across 12 evidence item(s). Overall confidence in this decision is high. Evidence sources reviewed: CIViC, COSMIC, ClinicalTrials.gov, OncoKB.

contraindications.detail: Variant in EGFR T790M has clinical significance 'resistance' indicating possible resistance to Osimertinib.
